question: What is the smallest exact-source observation and payoff-disable control that can identify Crown of the Hearth opportunity, terminal Ember and activation without changing acquisition priority or any unrelated gameplay mediator?

scientificBasis.observationRule: Enumerate the exact existing event and fixed-harvest routes. A route must identify per-fight Crown ownership, terminal Ember and Crown activation with at most one capture-gated harvest hook and four new fields.
scientificBasis.payoffRule: Enumerate the exact ways to disable the current three-HP-per-terminal-Ember payoff. A control must leave acquisition, ownership, terminal Ember, the Crown activation branch and RELIC_PROC event unchanged and may alter only the integer passed to the existing Crown heal call.
scientificBasis.separation: Observation and payoff are separate factors. This audit adds neither. Each receives its own exact identity estimand in the frozen preflight design below.
scientificBasis.noSearch: No outcome, policy support count, candidate score, simulator row, fitted model or qualitative ranking enters selection.

tools/balance_sim.gd: static func _trace_append(key: String, row: Dictionary) -> void:

observationEligibility.requiredFields: The selected row must link to the existing fight result and directly record Crown ownership, terminal cb.embers and the existing crownOfTheHearth RELIC_PROC activation.
observationEligibility.captureBoundary: All new data must be written only through the already identity-proved research_trace capture gate.
observationEligibility.identityBoundary: The exact 256-row current-main trace anchor must support capture-off versus capture-on and new-container-stripped comparisons.

observationSurfaces.hook: BalanceSim._harvest_fight, after its existing complete queue scan and before rewards
observationSurfaces.mechanism: The fixed harvest already has game.run.player.relics, game.cb.embers and every RELIC_PROC event. The fight index links to the existing result without duplicating it.
Directly identifies successful activation but cannot distinguish no Crown from Crown with zero terminal Ember and does not retain the terminal reserve.
A fight can retain its start value without emitting a later EMBER event, so the last event is not a complete terminal-state observation.
Would widen every simulator result row outside the existing research capture gate and is therefore broader than the selected trace row.

payoffControlEligibility.currentNull: Omitted and explicit integer three must execute the exact authored Crown heal path.
payoffControlEligibility.disabled: Integer zero must call the same heal function from the same branch and leave the Crown RELIC_PROC event, acquisition, ownership, terminal Ember and RNG unchanged.
payoffControlEligibility.directControls: The disabled level may enter only fixed synthetic controls before any whole-run causal cell.

payoffControls.runtimeHook: The existing `heal_player(run, null, cb.embers * 3)` integer multiplier only
payoffControls.mechanism: A research-only integer defaults to three, accepts only zero or three, and changes only the argument of the existing Crown heal call. The enclosing branch and following RELIC_PROC remain exact.
Skipping the branch also removes the Crown RELIC_PROC event, so it aliases activation with payoff.

payoffControls.runtimeHook: New relic content field plus CombatRules lookup
payoffControls.mechanism: Adds an unnecessary content-construction alias and repeats the constructor-identity risk that already closed weak-mend.
Conflates payoff with the already separate acquisition-priority factor.

scorelinePayoff.status: Separate fixed causal factor; not varied, observed or estimated.

afterimagePayoff.status: Separate fixed causal factor; not varied, observed or estimated.

hearthPayoffPerTerminalEmber.status: Separate binary causal factor with two exact null encodings. Disabled receives focused controls only in the identity preflight.

hearthAcquisitionPriority.status: Fixed at the already identity-safe current-main level throughout this audit and the payoff/telemetry identity preflight.

hearthTelemetry.status: Observation-only identity factor; never a gameplay or payoff factor.

aliasStructure.payoffNull: Omitted and explicit integer three intentionally alias current main and must be exact.
aliasStructure.payoffDisabled: Integer zero is not a null alias; it is a future causal treatment authorised only after direct mediator isolation and null identity pass.
aliasStructure.telemetry: Capture-on may differ only by the `hearthFights` trace container; stripping that container must reproduce the frozen trace exactly.
aliasStructure.priority: False is the fixed current-main acquisition level already proved exact; priority is not varied in this preflight.

mechanisticInteractions.targetLaterBlock: Hearth payoff by Hearth acquisition priority is the only mechanistically justified causal block after identity; it is not executed here.
mechanisticInteractions.emberHeart: Emberheart heals before Crown and can reduce Crown headroom. It is fixed authored Dusk context.
mechanisticInteractions.sunBlossom: Sun Blossom multiplies the Crown heal input by 1.5 inside the shared heal law. A fixed direct control must prove the expected multiplier without changing its ownership.
mechanisticInteractions.gravebloom: Gravebloom evaluates after Crown. Disabling Crown can cause a downstream Gravebloom threshold crossing; this is a preregistered consequence of the Crown-healing pathway, not a second knob or direct source edit.
mechanisticInteractions.maximumHp: The shared clamp can cap realised healing. A fixed direct control must cover limited headroom and a full-HP null.
mechanisticInteractions.emberSupplyAndSpend: Crown of Cinders, Kindle sources and automatic Art spend affect terminal Ember upstream. They remain natural fixed context and are not independently varied.
mechanisticInteractions.crossPackage: Scoreline and Afterimage remain separate. Shared anchors may later measure interference; no joint cell is authorised by this audit.

identityPreflightDesign.type: staged direct-mediator, payoff-null and observation-only identity preflight; not a causal experiment or factorial

directControls.matrix: Six fixed states by omitted current, explicit three and disabled zero = 18 executions.
states: Crown with two Embers and unrestricted HP headroom
Crown with two Embers and three HP headroom
Crown plus Sun Blossom with two Embers and unrestricted headroom
Crown with two Embers at full HP
directControls.estimand: Exact omitted-versus-three state, queue and RNG mismatch count; exact disabled differences in only realised Crown HP change, with Crown proc, Ember, queue order and RNG fixed.
directControls.stop: Do not run a whole-run arm unless all 18 fixed controls match exactly.

anchors.comparison: Omitted capture-off must match anchor core; omitted capture-on stripped only of `hearthFights` must match the complete anchor trace; capture-off and capture-on core rows must match; explicit three must match omitted capture-on exactly.

estimands.payoffNull: Exact mismatch counts for omitted versus explicit three across full rows, ordered trajectory, RNG and policy.
estimands.telemetryIdentity: Exact core-row mismatch count for capture-off versus capture-on and exact prior-trace mismatch count after stripping only `hearthFights`.
estimands.disabledMediator: Exact direct-control differences in Crown-attributable HP only, with acquisition, terminal Ember, activation event, queue order and RNG fixed.
estimands.notEstimated: No disabled whole-run outcome, causal payoff effect, interaction, detector, candidate, support count, duration, ML, RL or product endpoint.

stopping.firstLook: One 18-execution direct look, followed only on exact success by the three complete 256-row identity arms. No repair, rerun, cohort change, threshold change or disabled whole-run exists.
stopping.success: All direct controls pass; all 768 identity rows complete; every prescribed null, core, trace, RNG and policy mismatch count is zero; ledger identity is exact; and execution finishes within 300 seconds.
stopping.futility: Any completed direct or whole-run identity comparison differs, any cohort is incomplete or ledger identity changes.
stopping.inconclusive: Execution errors, times out or cannot produce an exact decision at the cap.

factorDisposition.candidate: None is constructed, simulated or promoted.
factorDisposition.causalRows: None are authorised by this audit or the identity preflight.
factorDisposition.additionalMethod: No ML, RL, optimiser, fitted model or new policy mapping is used or authorised.
factorDisposition.protectedSeeds: Acceptance seeds 3000-5199 and reserve seeds 5200-5399 remain unused.

executionAndStopping.construction: Deterministic Python owns exact source identity, route gates, factor selection, ledger identity and stop/go.
executionAndStopping.firstLook: One complete fixed audit of four observation routes and four payoff controls. No source edit, trace, simulator row, subset, ranking, repair or rerun exists.
executionAndStopping.successStop: Stop when exactly one observation surface and one payoff control pass every frozen gate within 30 seconds.
executionAndStopping.futilityStop: Stop and close the Hearth route when either side has no eligible option.
executionAndStopping.inconclusiveStop: Stop at the cap when either side has multiple eligible options or any exact identity is unavailable.

decisionRules.success: Exactly one observation surface and one payoff control pass all frozen gates, exact source and ledger identity are intact, and the 30-second cap is not exceeded.
decisionRules.successAuthority: Apply decision boundary 1 and freeze only the four-field capture-gated Hearth harvest row and exact Crown-heal input scalar for the separately frozen 18-control plus 768-row identity preflight. Implement no other hook or field. Run no disabled whole-run, causal block, Scoreline or Afterimage cell, candidate, ML, RL, optimiser or protected seed before that identity decision.
decisionRules.futility: No observation surface or no payoff control passes every gate.
decisionRules.futilityAuthority: Apply decision boundary 2 and close the Hearth payoff route without inventing telemetry, changing acquisition, adding a content field, skipping the activation branch or weakening the gates. Continue with the next evidence-backed structural mechanism inside issue #421.
decisionRules.inconclusive: More than one observation surface or payoff control remains eligible, an exact input is unavailable or the cap expires.
decisionRules.inconclusiveAuthority: Apply decision boundary 3 and record the audit inconclusive at the cap without implementation, simulator row, candidate, method or protected seed.
